description: The Singer Heavy Duty family compared as people search it: forum and roundup reports of one head, three stitch counts and three bundles.
summary: Forum and roundup reports describe one head across the three. Buy the 4452 if you'd use the extra presser feet, the 4423 if you won't. The 4432 is hard to justify between them.

buyIf.singer-4452: You would buy the extra presser feet anyway. The bundle is the whole difference, per third-party reports.
